title: Practice 2: до того как, после того как, о том что…

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: It's crucial that you wash your hands after coughing or sneezing.
exercises.ru: Очень важно мыть руки после ___, как покашляешь или чихнёшь.
exercises.why: «When a preposition refers to a whole clause, a complex conjunction is used consisting of: 1) the preposition, 2) the pronoun "то" in the case required by the preposition, 3) a linking word»: до того как, перед тем как, о том что, за то что, вместо того чтобы. — DLI, Lesson 92.
